visual: Very large bright-yellow double blooms · dark-green foliage · upright stems
water: Keep evenly moist; water in dry spells
prune: Deadhead regularly; cut back after frost and lift tubers
hardinessNote: RHS H3; lift and store tubers in colder areas
uses: cut flowers · borders · containers · cottage gardens
uncertain: RHS gives 0.5–1 m height and 0.1–0.5 m spread; UK specialist sources commonly give about 70–100 cm tall and 30–50 cm wide
Flowering windows vary between June–September, July–October and midsummer to frost; Jun-Oct represents the practical UK ornamental period
